units.translation: Therefore for them the deed is accomplished.
Go out to the deep meadow of Lerna.
Let some woman who brings fulfillment come out of the house.
The equal-voting justice truly came out.
They devour the ancient nature with lichens.
But beware lest the blast of the wave strike you.
Such are the inventions of those men.
Such a shameful bond did the young ruler of the blessed ones devise against me.
Number, outstanding among inventions, they discovered (M has ἐξεῦρον and at 96 ἐξεῦρ᾽) for themselves.
Having devised such contrivances, wretched one, for mortals.
Who would say that he found gold before me?
You have come into the sight of those things which you long prayed for.
He boasts that the deed is greater than the suffering.
You would boast of your race and speak further.
We boast that we are Argive by race.

Phrynichus's note in Bekker's Anecdota p. 37, 17 refers to this passage: ἔξηβον [past youth]: this is new. The common word is ἔξωρον [past season]. Phrynichus said this rightly: for ἔξηβον [past youth] is read nowhere else. In the gloss of Hesychius ἔξηβος [past youth]: ἔξω τῆς ἥβης [beyond youth]. τριάκοντα πέντε ἐτῶν [thirty-five years], I fear that the words τριάκοντα πέντε ἐτῶν [thirty-five years] were not written by the original author of the gloss, who no doubt also had in mind the passage of Aeschylus. Other compounds of this sort with ἐξ [out of], no less foreign to common usage, are ἐκγενής [born of], ἔκτιμος [dishonored] and ἐξόμιλος [out of company] in Sophocles.
